title: Surface CI probe annotations and streamed footer headings
problem: GitHub checks failures in Footer Chromium probe (workflows 40387187938 and 40409123749) write diagnostics only to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, leaving public check annotations blank when raw logs return HTTP 403, and scripts/probe-end.mjs reads main h1 on /dashboard after a fixed 450ms pause while app/(site)/(app)/dashboard/loading.tsx can still stream a headingless skeleton under CI load.
action_items: Implement scripts/ci-probe-annotate.mjs to execute or post-process non-TAP CI steps, preserve exact child exit codes under pipefail, write bounded escaped step summaries when GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY is set, and emit GitHub workflow ::error title=...::... lines to stdout (escaping %, \r, \n, : and ,) with failed assertions, counts, and bounded next-start.log tails including missing-log handling.

Wire scripts/ci-probe-annotate.mjs into .github/workflows/ci.yml around Real CPU camera and privacy verifier, Motion probe, signed in, Footer walk, and Footer Chromium probe while retaining exact bash scripts/walk-end.sh and bash scripts/probe-end.sh invocations required by lib/end.test.ts and scripts/ci-workflow.test.mjs.

Update scripts/probe-end.mjs around the local 390x844 reduced-motion 403 exit check so after navigation to /projects or /dashboard it observes a rendered non-empty main h1 within a bounded 10s timeout instead of sampling loading.tsx's headingless skeleton after 450ms; preserve all existing probe assertions and scripts/probe-motion-signed-in.mjs.

Add scripts/ci-probe-annotate.test.mjs (exercising workflow shell execution against exit-7 and exit-0 fixtures, ::error escaping, and missing next-start.log) and scripts/probe-end-stream.test.mjs (exercising a 1.5s delayed streamed /dashboard heading positive control and a missing-heading timeout negative control). Extend scripts/ci-workflow.test.mjs, update architecture.md, run local gates including check-gate-closure.mjs, and stop at tested commit and push. If a person-only prerequisite appears, raise plan_manager_ask_user(kind=operator_action) immediately at task start.
non_goals: weakening or deleting any Footer walk, Footer Chromium probe, or signed-in motion assertion
changing public route UI or Bottle and Peep-box styles
polling CI or deployed endpoints from inside the SWE run
acceptance_criteria: Any failure in CI camera, signed-in motion, Footer walk, or Footer Chromium probe preserves its nonzero exit status while emitting escaped ::error workflow annotations with the failing assertion and bounded server log tail, and probe-end.mjs resolves streamed /dashboard headings deterministically without skeleton races while failing when headings remain absent.
